Verses.Text: 1. My only hope is you Jesus, My only hope is you, From early in the morning, till late at night, My only hope is you.
2. My only Joy is your Jesus, My only Joy is you, From early in the morning till late at night, My only Joy is you.
3. My only Peace is your Jesus, My only Peace is you, I rom early in the morning till late at night, My only Peace is you.
4. All that I need is you Jesus, All that I need is you, From early in the morning till late at night, All that I need is you.
5. From early in the morning, till late at night, My only Hope is you, From early in the morning till late at night, My only Joy is you.
6. From early in the morning, till late at night, My only Peace is you, From early in the morning till late at night, All that I need is you.

1. How do you explain, How do you describe, A love that goes from East- to West
As deep as it is wide... You know all our hopes you know all our fears, And words cannot express the love, We long for you to hear.

So listen to our hearts, Hear our spirit sing, A song of praise that flows. For those you have redeemed, We will use the words we know, To tell you what an awesome God you are, But words are not enough to tell you of our love, So listen to our hearts.

2. (Sop) If words can fall like rain, From these lips of mine, And if I had a thousand years, Lord I would still run out of time, If you listen to my heart, Every beat will say
Thank you for the life thank you for the truth thank you for the way.

2. (All) If words could fall like rain, From these lips of mine, And if I had a thousand years, I'd still run out of time, listen to my heart, Every beat will say, Thank you for the life the truth, And thank you for the way.

1. What a song of delight in that city so bright, We'll be wafted neath heaven's fair dome, How the ransomed will raise happy songs in his praise When all of God's singers get home.
When all of God's singers get home, Where never a sorrow will come; There'll be no place like home, When all of God's singers get home.
2. As we sing here on earth, songs of sadness or mirth, 'Tis a fortaste of rapture to come; But our joy can't compare with the glory up there, When all of God's singers get home.
When all of God's singers get home, Where never a sorrow will come; There'll be no place like home, When all of God's singers get home.
3. Having overcome sin, "hallelujah, amen," Will be heard in that land o'er the foam, Every heart will be light and each face will be bright, When all of God's singers get home.
When all of God's singers get home, Where never a sorrow will come; There'll be no place like home, When all of God's singers get home.
